index: Mantis makes a unique web link. Put it in a file, on a device, or on a web page. When a person or a tool loads that link, Mantis can send you an alert. Opening a file may not load its link, so test it first. Use the full server to keep a list of keys and hits. Use edge to send hits to your own alert tool. You need to set up one of these before using Mantis. The demo here is pretend and sends no alerts.
about: Mantis helps you notice when a web link is used. You can put links in files or use them with device events. A hit shows that a request happened. It does not prove who made it or why. The full version stores hits and can try failed alerts again. Edge sends hits to another tool. Mantis is still early software, so changes may affect your setup.
docs: This page helps you find the right guide. Start with Getting started to set up Mantis and make a test key. The other guides explain files, devices, alerts, and places to run the server. A server on your laptop must stay on and online to receive hits. Most guides are on a separate website.
privacy: This site has no ads or visitor tracking scripts. Cloudflare hosts it and can process your IP address and request details. The site asks GitHub whether the product's checks passed. It saves your theme, reading choices, and a short-lived check result in your browser. Demo commands stay on this page. If you follow an outside link, that site's own rules apply. The Mantis software handles its own data separately.
legal: This website and the Mantis product use different licences. A licence tells you how you may use the code. The website uses Apache-2.0. Mantis's own code uses MIT. Other packages have their own terms, and one full-server package uses AGPL. The table lists exact package versions from the source we checked. Check the licence for the version you use.
404: We could not find this page. Use the Home link or the documentation link to keep going.
accessibility: You can use this site with a keyboard. You can change the text size, spacing, and colors. Animation is off unless you turn it on. If a word is new to you, use the glossary. We aim to meet the highest WCAG level, but more testing with assistive technology is still needed.
glossary: This page explains words used on the Mantis website. Terms are in alphabetical order. Use your browser's Find command to look for a word. These notes explain the site; they do not replace a setup guide or a licence.
